description: This file implements PCI device information retrieval using libpci, including dynamic loading of libpci shared library, and functions to scan PCI bus for GPU devices on a Raspberry Pi 4 platform.

classes.name: LibPCI
classes.description: A helper class that dynamically loads libpci and retrieves function pointers for PCI operations.

methods.name: GetPCIDevicesWithLibPCI
methods.description: Scans PCI bus for GPU devices and fills provided vector with device info.
